(b) Placem page, "Placement" section:
"Kenya Universities and Colleges Central Placement Service (KUCCPS) coordinates the placement of students to universities, Teacher Training Colleges (TTCs), National Polytechnics, ..."

Placem page, "Minimum Requirements" section (verbatim list):
"Degree: C+ and above
Diploma/Level 6: C and C -
Certificate/Level 5: D+ and D
Artisan/Level 4: D - and E"

Placem page, "Applicant Eligibility" section:
"2. Have sat for the Kenya Certificate of Secondary Education (KCSE) Examination.
3. Meet the minimum requirements to apply for placement for degree, diploma, certificate and artisan courses."
Also: "Candidates must meet the minimum admission requirements as published on the KUCCPS Student's Portal" (Placement Criteria, item 2).
